correctness.rationale: At p=3, cube images of 1+3Z_3 and -1+3Z_3 are uniform cosets ±1+9Z_3: the Hensel change of variable t+3t²+3t³ has derivative 1 mod 3. Partition input pairs into unit/unit equal or opposite signs, exactly one unit, and both divisible by 3; the last event has probability 1/9 and scales output by 27, producing F_n(a)=h(a)+3*1_{27|a}F_{n-3}(a/27) for n>=3, with F1=1 and F2=h+1_{a=0 mod9}. Squaring and averaging with mean F=1 yields M_n=2+M_{n-3}/3, bases 1,1,19/9. Annuli 27^k(9Z_3\27Z_3) give F=3^(k+1)-1 on Haar mass 2/27^(k+1), proving the sharp L^s cutoff s<3; conditional expectations prove almost-everywhere and L^s convergence. Independently enumerated every target for n=0..6 and all exact collision fractions. Infinite conclusion rests on the Hensel/measure recursion, not enumeration.
